entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Showers turning to snow Sunday afternoon about the summit and may lower to 800 metres in the evening. Expect 3 to 6 cm about the summit with lesser amounts to 800 metres. Note, this warning may be extended into Monday evening.

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Showers turning to snow Sunday afternoon about the summit and may lower to 600 metres during Monday morning. Expect 8 to 15 cm or more about the summit with lesser amounts to 600 metres.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Strong Wind Watch
entry.summary: Westerly winds may approach severe gale in exposed places from Sunday afternoon and will likely reach severe gale on Monday. Impact: Damage to trees, powerlines, and unsecured structures possible. Driving may be difficult, especially for high-sided vehicles and motorcycles. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: High.

entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: On top of what has already fallen, expect 30 to 60 mm of rain, mainly east of Whakatane, possibly more in localised downpours. Peak rates of 15 to 25 mm/h, but possibly 25 to 40 mm/hr in downpours. Rain clearing from the west early Sunday morning. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal.
